## v2.3.0

### Added

- Added propagation-node discovery, automatic or fixed manual selection, direct-send fallback, and an always-propagated delivery option.
- Added propagation inbox retrieval for messages held while the handheld is offline.
- Added short Codec2 700C voice messages on supported T-Deck, T-Pager, and Cardputer Adv hardware, with recording preview and inline playback controls.
- Added individual message selection, copying, and deletion through each device's touch, wheel, or keyboard controls.
- Added a saved limit for voice clips on internal storage, defaulting to two. Older audio is removed while its chat message remains; SD-card storage has no clip-count limit.

### Fixed and improved

- Reduced conversation-loading work and reused recently opened chat history.
- Improved recording, repeated playback, pause/resume, and audio-memory cleanup on constrained devices.
- Returned to the conversation after sending a voice message and kept unsent clips only for the active conversation.
- Announced the default device name so peers can display it in discovery and chats.
- Corrected T-Pager charging-state handling across shutdown and firmware modes.
- Unified launcher titles as Ratspeak and simplified chat navigation and message controls.

### Build and compatibility

- Compact voice messages work with the accompanying Ratspeak app update after it receives the handheld's announce. ThinkNode M9 has no supported audio hardware.
- Hub/channel support and live handheld calls remain unavailable in this release.
- Handheld firmware remains in beta. Cardputer requires a Cap LoRa-1262 with an antenna for LoRa.
- Factory ZIP installations erase settings, identity, and internal message history. Back up anything you want to keep before installing.
